propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack local clone, Gerrit access, shell network, or mounted tracker but retain GitHub connector and repository visibility; guidance must teach environment-capability detection and define when native ticket creation becomes impossible.

Native ticket creation is impossible when both (a) the tracker-worktree dimension fails (no accessible `tickets` branch checkout) AND (b) the network/remote dimension fails or the native `rebar`/`rebar-mcp` binary is unavailable.

When native creation is impossible, the session must produce a reviewable payload conforming to `export.schema.json`'s required fields (schema_version=1, agent-generated UUID4 ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status=open) plus description with Acceptance Criteria and optional parent_id, without claiming persistence.

The `rebar import` tool silently skips records missing `ticket_id` or `ticket_type` in dry-run mode with no counter increment or warning; malformed records are detectable only by comparing `would_create + skipped` against total NDJSON line count.

All writes to the tracker must use the locked append/commit path (`rebar import` or equivalent library call); raw hand-authored tracker mutations and direct GitHub Contents API writes to the `tickets` branch are unsafe and prohibited.

Documentation must explicitly prohibit hand-authoring or modifying event files, require search-before-create and native parent/child creation when live tracker is accessible, state that GitHub is read-only for code changes, and recommend `rebar validate` or `rebar fsck` after import.
